row.title: Ford Protect Premium Maintenance Plans | Zeigler Ford ESP | Save $$ on Genuine Ford Protect Extended
row.summary: Ford Protect Premium Maintenance Plans, offered by Zeigler Ford ESP, are prepaid vehicle maintenance programs designed to cover routine services like oil changes, tire rotations, fluid replacements, and inspections for Ford and Lincoln vehicles. These plans aim to reduce out-of-pocket costs by bundling scheduled maintenance into a single upfront purchase, with options varying by mileage and duration. They are sold alongside Ford Protect extended service plans (ESPs) and are available for both new and certified pre-owned vehicles. The target audience is Ford and Lincoln owners seeking predictable maintenance expenses and factory-backed coverage. Zeigler Ford ESP markets these plans as a cost-saving alternative to paying per visit, emphasizing genuine Ford parts and qualified service.
